name: Code World Models Benchmark (CWMB)
description: CWMB is a benchmark suite of program synthesis and planning tasks for evaluating code world models generated by large language models in reinforcement learning environments. It includes 18 diverse RL environments with textual descriptions and curated trajectories to test code generation and planning capabilities.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark from the code-world-models line of work, mainly used in research on LLM planning and code generation in RL environments.
notes: Introduces a new code generation strategy GIF-MCTS and demonstrates improved sample efficiency and inference speed in model-based RL.
